kinds.about: Graphic packs: one folder per pack holding its rules.txt, as Cemu's graphicPacks/<pack> (a downloaded pack sits one or two folders deeper: place the folder that holds rules.txt). Every installed pack is switched on with its default presets.
kinds.doc: Cemu v2.6 walks graphicPacks recursively, testing each folder with is_directory and exists, which follow a link, and loads a folder holding rules.txt without descending into it (GraphicPack2.cpp:64-79); the directory iterator does not follow a linked folder, so each pack is linked on its own, never a folder of packs. It writes there only from its downloader window, which a fullscreen launch never opens (DownloadGraphicPacksWindow.cpp:91-100). A pack runs only when settings.xml names its rules.txt in a GraphicPack Entry (CemuConfig.cpp:179-205); with no Preset its default presets apply. Cemu matches an entry first by the absolute rules path as it walked it, through the link (GraphicPack2.cpp:90-97), then by the path relative to its data folder, which fs::relative works out from the canonical path (GraphicPack2.cpp:522-525, helpers.cpp:313-321) and so points into the library for a linked pack. Semu therefore writes one Entry per installed pack with the absolute path under the target (entry_lines); a pack placed in the library runs on the next launch and a pack taken out stops. Observed in the podman VM: Captain Toad (US) logged Activate graphic pack for the linked CaptainToad_Resolution.

mods.doc: Dormant until a pack is placed: the library is <paths.mods>/cemu/graphicpacks/<pack>, one link per pack into ${state_root}/data/Cemu/graphicPacks, each enabled in settings.xml while it is installed.

doc.runtime: Linux launches the exact source-built package from the asset root. -f starts fullscreen, -m selects Semu's isolated MLC, and -g consumes exactly one following Wii U title. The Steam Deck system definition selects file inputs; upstream Cemu additionally understands an extracted title root containing code, content, and meta. No host executable, Flatpak, libretro core, or prebuilt binary participates.
doc.state: Cemu reads settings from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Cemu and data from $XDG_DATA_HOME/Cemu. -m pins the writable MLC, including normal title saves under mlc01/usr/save, below ${state_root}/data/Cemu/mlc01. keys.txt is copied only when its isolated target is absent, preferring the bounded user-owned ${semu_home}/firmware/cemu import; an adjacent NUS title.tik remains in the read-only ROM tree. External keys, tickets, ROMs, BIOS material, and existing saves are never modified.
doc.input: controllerProfiles/controller0.xml is Cemu's automatically loaded player-one profile. It pins the Steam Virtual Gamepad through SDL and maps the complete Wii U GamePad surface. Ctrl+Q quits and Ctrl+Tab swaps the selected TV/GamePad view. Upstream Cemu 2.6 has no savestate implementation, so state.save and state.load are declared unsupported in profile.json rather than mapped to inert chords.
doc.rendering: Vulkan is forced through settings.xml (api 1). VK_LAYER_SEMU_compositor (render_vulkan) composes Semu's bezel and shader into the swapchain image at present.
doc.display: Cemu's wx/GTK window is blank under GDK's Wayland backend; GDK_BACKEND=x11 runs it on XWayland, where it renders.
doc.content: The title formats Cemu a6fb0a48 detects (src/Cafe/TitleList/TitleInfo.cpp:186-252: .rpx, .wud/.wux/.iso discs, .wua archives, .wuhb bundles); a loose .rpx also boots as a standalone title (src/Cafe/CafeSystem.cpp:798).

save_states.doc: Cemu 2.6 has no save states (profile.json actions.unsupported).

menu.doc: Cemu declares no pause action, so the Semu menu draws over the running game; on Linux it holds the pad while it is open, so the game sees none of the menu's input.
